{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the 'severity' column for 'SEVERE'
print("Severity categories:", df['severity'].unique())

# Check if there are any patients with 'SEVERE' disease
severe_count = df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of patients with SEvere disease: {severe_count}")

# Check the baseline biomarker column for -999 sentinels
print("Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check the 'patient_id' for duplicates
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check the assay_batch for batch B (which requires correction)
print("Batch A and B counts:", df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
